title: Zymo Quick-DNA-RNA MagBead Kit
author: Opentrons
materials: Bead drying- pause to let beads air dry.

steps.title: Bind nucleic acids to beads
steps.instruction: Suspend the magnetic beads by mixing, dispense the bead suspension into the wells of a deep‑well plate placed on the Magnetic Module, pause the deck to mix the plate on an off‑deck heater‑shaker, engage the magnets for 7 minutes, then remove and discard the supernatant into the liquid waste reservoir.

steps.title: Perform four wash cycles
steps.instruction: For each of four wash steps: transfer wash buffer from the reagent reservoir to the wells of the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix the beads with the buffer, engage the magnets for 7 minutes, and discard the supernatant into the liquid waste reservoir.

steps.title: DNAse I treatment (optional)
steps.instruction: If preparing DNA‑free RNA, add DNAse I to the wells of the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix, and incubate with occasional mixing (duration as defined by protocol parameters). Skip this step when the output is combined DNA and RNA.

steps.title: Stop DNase reaction
steps.instruction: Add stop buffer to the wells of the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix, incubate for 10 minutes with occasional mixing, engage the magnets for 7 minutes, and transfer the supernatant to the liquid waste reservoir.

steps.title: Perform two ethanol washes
steps.instruction: For each of two ethanol wash steps: transfer ethanol wash buffer from the reagent reservoir to the wells of the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix the beads, engage the magnets for 7 minutes, and discard the supernatant into the liquid waste reservoir.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ethanol wash buffer to wells

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol to allow the magnetic beads to air‑dry (no additional reagents added).

steps.title: Elute RNA into collection plate
steps.instruction: Add elution buffer to the wells of the deep‑well plate on the Magnetic Module, mix, engage the magnets for 7 minutes, and transfer the eluate to an elution plate that is held at 4 °C on the Temperature Module.
